L'envergure domine la pose ; l'ancre est un axe de vol, pas un contact plantaire natif. Aucun battement animé fourni. One static drawing. Native generated pixels unchanged; no resize, crop, alpha painting or other pixel processing. Very low alpha noise can extend beyond readable bounds.

selected.prompt: Create exactly one transparent full-body AIR SCREAMER combat presentation sprite from Silent Hill: Book of Memories (PS Vita, 2012), matching the attached native gameplay screenshot and bestiary portrait. Image 1 establishes its entire body and complete wings; image 2 clarifies the small skull-like pale head and wing membrane material. Use this specific BoM version, not the SH1 model or a generic dragon. The creature is a thin skeletal winged monster with a small narrow pale skull/beak-like head, elongated thin neck and body, two enormous leathery muted pink-grey/brown batlike wings with dark bony spars, and two thin dangling legs with grasping talons. No tail, horns, feathers, clothing or added limbs. Pose it hovering in a calm flight idle, entire body in STRICT SIDE PROFILE FACING RIGHT; head and beak point to the right, shoulders and torso side-on. Wings are spread up and back as in an arrested wingbeat, one near wing and the partly visible far wing; all membrane tips remain fully in frame and separately readable. Show both complete talon feet below the body. Reconstruct a clear 2D versus presentation while preserving its native wingspan/body ratio, spare anatomy and muted materials. One creature only, no player, HUD, room or floor, no dust or motion trails. True transparent alpha PNG, clean isolated silhouette, 10% clear margin on every side. Detailed game sprite with restrained realistic surface detail, no invented ornate textures. One static full-body image, not a sprite sheet.

selected.prompt: Edit the supplied Insane Cancer BoM sprite (image 1) into a clean TRUE SIDE PROFILE FACING RIGHT with fully transparent background. Image 2 is the native Book of Memories design reference. Keep the existing exact creature design, huge swollen belly, pale grey-pink skin folds, tiny sunken nearly featureless head, heavy hanging arms and small complete feet. Rotate the torso a little farther to the right so its chest faces the right edge, not the camera; the near shoulder/arm overlap the far shoulder/arm in profile, face/belly and all toes point right. Keep both whole feet visible in a small stagger. Remove ALL surrounding grey/pink fog, halo and soft background glow: every pixel outside the crisp creature silhouette, including space between legs, must be transparent alpha. Do not paint a floor or a shadow. Fit the complete subject on a portrait transparent canvas with at least 8% clear border around head, hands, belly and feet. Do not change anatomy, add clothes, text, wounds, eyes, weapons, human facial features or extra details. One complete static game sprite; actual transparent PNG, no scene, no UI.
